title: 1Password passes $500M in ARR, up from $400M in November 2025, driven by enterprise AI coding assistants and agents, and announces 1Password for Agents (Elias Schisgall/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Elias Schisgall / Wall Street Journal: 1Password passes $500M in ARR, up from $400M in November 2025, driven by enterprise AI coding assistants and agents, and announces 1Password for Agents — And the free cash flow margin is in the double digits amid an explosion in coding assistants and agents in enterprise settings
